title: Russian Potato and Galette Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting dish featuring sliced potatoes, a crispy galette crust, and a hint of Russian flair.

ingredients.name: aerated
ingredients.notes: flaky pastry dough, used for topping

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes and a pinch of salt.
Roll out the galette sheet to a thickness of about 1/8 inch (3 mm).
Transfer the potatoes to one half of the galette, leaving a 1-inch (2.5 cm) border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the galette over the potatoes, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the galette with a little bit of water and sprinkle with aerated pastry dough.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
